s: Sekar lebishat hatztzitzit veonshah ubo ch' seipim: ap-al-pi sheen adam chayyab liqnot tallit bat arba kenapot kede sheyyitchayyeb betzitzit, ella davqa im rotzeh lehitlabbesh betallit bat arba kenapot chayyab lehatil bah tzitzit, mikkol maqom tob venakon lihyot kol adam zahir vezariz lilbosh tallit metzuyyetzet kol hayyom, kede sheyyizkor hammitzvot bekol rega. Dugma laddabar, keadam hammazhir lachabero al inyan echad, sheqqosher qesher baazoro kede sheyyizkerennu. Veal ken yesh betzitzit chamishsha qesharim — keneged chamishsha chumshe tora, vearba kenapot — kede shellekol tzad sheyyipneh yizkor hammitzvot:
Apillu mi sheeno yakol lehitlabbesh betzitzit kol hayyom, lekol happachot yizzaher sheyyihyeh labush betzitzit bishat qeriat shema utepilla:
Mitzva laasot tallit naa vetzitzit naa, vehu haddin kol hammitzvot tzarik laasotan behiddur bekol mah deepshar, shenneemar: "zeh eli veanvehu" — hitnaeh lepanayv bemitzvot:

Mitzva leechoz hatztzitzit beyado hassemalit keneged libbo bishat qeriat shema, remez laddabar: "vehayu haddebarim haelleh al lebabeka". Veyesh mi sheomer sheyyeechoz otam ben qemitza lezeret shel semol, ukesheyyaggia leparashat tzitzit — yiqqachem beyado haymanit veyabbit bahem, veyihyu beyado ad sheyyaggia le"neemanim venechemadim laad", veaz yenashsheq hatztzitzit visirem miyyado:
Tob lehistakkel batztzitzit bishat atipa keshemmebarek alehem, shenneemar: "ureitem oto uzekartem vego'" — reiyya mebi lide zekira uzekira mebi lide asiyya:

Yesh nohagin lehistakkel batztzitzit keshemmaggia le"ureitem oto" velitten otam al haenayim, uminhag yapeh hu vechibbube mitzva. Vegam nohagin lenashsheq hatztzitzit beshaa shemmistakkel bahen, vehakkol hu chibbub mitzva:

Keshemmistakkel batztzitzit — yistakkel bishte tzitziyyot shellepanayv sheyyesh bahem asara qesharim, remez leeser sepirot shehen qeshurin vaachudin zeh bazeh. Vegam yesh bahem shishsha asar chutin vaasara qesharim — olim k"v keshem hvy"h baruk hu:
Gadol onesh hambattel mitzvat tzitzit, vealayv neemar: "leechoz bekanpot haaretz vego'". Vekol hazzahir bemitzvat tzitzit — zokeh veroeh pene hashshekina:
